opening.argument: The speaker presents Forsage as a route to passive income, promising money while the viewer is not working. He ties that opportunity to financial participation, explaining that viewers can “simply purchase a position or fund a position however you want to put it.” The appeal is reinforced by immediate pressure: “don't hesitate. Really. Don't hesitate. It's going up. Now's the time to jump in.” He then directs viewers to an external website to learn more. Taken together, the passive-income promise, required purchase or funding, urgency, and diversion pathway establish an investment-pool or staking-style solicitation rather than a neutral discussion of cryptocurrency.
